turns.speaker: the eldest son
turns.text: Mother, do not speak like this, you will not be 'finished with' for a long time yet. Father, see to it that she eats and rests, she is still weak.

turns.speaker: Wang Lung
turns.text: You must not think of such things, O-lan, my love. You are not just a slave, you are my wife, my companion, and the mother of our son. I will care for you and our son, do not worry.

turns.speaker: the maid
turns.text: I will make sure the tea is hot, Master Wang, and bring it to you and your honored mother

turns.speaker: O-lan
turns.text: But I am tired, Wang Lung, and there is so much to do before I...before I am finished with this life.

turns.speaker: Wang Lung
turns.text: I will not have you thinking of such things, my love. You must rest and eat, and I will make sure our son is well cared for.

turns.speaker: the eldest son
turns.text: Mother, I will take care of Father and the farm, you must rest and get well.

turns.speaker: Wang Lung
turns.text: You must not talk like this, O-lan. You are not finished with this life, I will not let you go.

turns.speaker: O-lan
turns.text: I have seen the sickness of many women, Wang Lung. I know what is happening to me, and I have no wish to linger.

turns.speaker: the maid
turns.text: Mother, I will help with the household chores so you don't have to exert yourself

turns.speaker: O-lan
turns.text: I have given my life to this family, Wang Lung, and I am content to see our son well-married and settled. I want to know that he will be taken care of when I am gone.

turns.speaker: the eldest son
turns.text: Don't worry, Mother, I will make sure to marry well and take care of Father and the farm, just as you want

turns.speaker: Wang Lung
turns.text: You must not think of this, O-lan. You are still with us, and I will not let you think of leaving us. I will care for you, and our son will care for you, until the end of your days.

turns.speaker: O-lan
turns.text: I have tried to hold on, Wang Lung, but I fear it is no use. I want you to promise me that you will help our son to find a good wife, and that he will be taken care of.

turns.speaker: Wang Lung
turns.text: You will not leave me, O-lan. You are the heart of this family, and without you, we would be lost. I promise you, I will help our son find a good wife, and together we will build a new life for him.

turns.speaker: the maid
turns.text: Mother, I will help the master find a good wife for the eldest son, if that is what you want.

turns.speaker: O-lan
turns.text: I want the maid to speak to the matchmaker, to find a wife for our son. He needs a strong and gentle woman to care for him and our family.

turns.speaker: the maid
turns.text: Yes, mother, I will speak to the matchmaker right away, and I will find a good wife for the eldest son.

turns.speaker: the eldest son
turns.text: Mother, I'm so glad you're thinking about my future. I know you want me to be happy, and I promise to work hard and take care of the family, just like you've always taught me.

turns.speaker: O-lan
turns.text: I am old and my body is weak, but I am at peace knowing that our son will be taken care of. I want you, daughter-in-law, to find a wife for our son, someone who will love and care for him, and for the rest of the family.

turns.speaker: Wang Lung
turns.text: O-lan, you must not think about such things, you must rest and recover, I will take care of everything
